summary: Comprehensive backend testing of Neno la Leo module (/api/neno-la-leo/*). All 30 tests passed covering admin leaders CRUD, pending-leaders/approve, admin neno CRUD with status filters, verse_reference formatting (range + single verse + recomputation on update), Swahili day name, expires_at=word_date+30d, is_active logic for scheduled vs immediate publish, /active enrichment with leader info+display_date+leader_display, single neno GET, play tracking incrementing both neno + leader stats (reading/reflection), delete decrementing leader.stats.total_neno, and verification that _id is never leaked.

minor.issue: publish_datetime is constructed from naive ISO string and compared by replacing tzinfo with UTC. If publish_time is meant as local/Tanzania time, the is_active gating could be off by the local offset. Consider explicit timezone in payload or server-side.
When publish_date/time updated, publish_datetime is stored as raw 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00' (no timezone) whereas create uses .isoformat() — inconsistent format vs create path.
Uses publish_datetime>{now.isoformat()} but stored value is naive ISO; works only because comparisons are lexical on strings. Fragile if format changes.
No auth check — anyone can hit /admin/leaders, /admin/neno create/update/delete. get_admin_from_token helper is defined but never used. HIGH severity if exposed publicly.
audio_type silently coerced to 'reading' for invalid values instead of returning 400 — masks client bugs.
Decrements leader stats.total_neno without floor — could go negative if data inconsistent.

action_items: HIGH: Add admin authentication enforcement on all /admin/* endpoints (currently public). The helper get_admin_from_token exists but is not invoked.
Normalize publish_datetime format in update path to use .isoformat() (matches create path).
Consider returning 400 on invalid audio_type for /play instead of defaulting to 'reading'.
Optional: prevent leader stats.total_neno from going below 0 in delete.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints under /api/neno-la-leo/admin/* are NOT protected — they accept any unauthenticated request. This is a HIGH severity security gap.
Inconsistent publish_datetime serialization between create (.isoformat()) and update (raw string).
format_verse_reference + get_swahili_day_name working correctly and well-isolated.
_id is consistently excluded across all queries — good.
datetime.fromisoformat with date-only string works in Python 3.11 but is implicit; consider date.fromisoformat for clarity.
File length 672 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; could be split into leaders.py / neno.py / upload.py submodules.
test_credentials: Used existing leader leader_c6f3f6973c2c. Created and cleaned up test leaders/neno entries.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ leaders/neno entries during the run; all cleaned up at the end via the test_cleanup_* tests. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 30 tests are in /app/backend/tests/test_neno_la_leo.py and use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Cleanup is built-in. Existing seed (neno_9aaffe3ec7ed by leader_c6f3f6973c2c) is left untouched. Admin endpoints are unauthenticated — main agent should add auth before production.
rca of the issue: n/a — feature implementation is functionally correct; only auth + minor consistency issues noted.
